Wikidata item Appearance move to sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Japanese film director and cinematographer Daisaku Kimura Daisaku Kimura Born ( 1939-07-13 ) July 13, 1939 (age 86) Tokyo-Fu , Japan Occupations Film director , cinematographer Daisaku Kimura ( 木村 大作 , Kimura Daisaku ) is a Japanese film director and cinematographer. Overviews [ edit ] Kimura received the certificate of the Person of Cultural Merit from Hinako Yokota (November 4, 2020) He won the award for best director at the 33rd Japan Academy Prize for Mt. Tsurugidake . [ 1 ] Filmography [ edit ] Submersion of Japan (1973, cinematographer) Mt. Tsurugidake (2009, director) Climbing to Spring (2014, director) Samurai's Promise (2018, director) Hara o Kukutte (2027, director) [ 2 ] Honours [ edit ] Person of Cultural Merit (2020) References [ edit ] ^ "第 33 回日本アカデミー賞優秀作品" (in Japanese).
